devices.name: Sontex - HCA 565 (heating cost allocator, Sontex Radio)
devices.description: Heating cost allocator with Sontex Radio (433 MHz). OMS/wM-Bus compatible data records (EN 13757-3).

devices.name: Sontex - HCA 566 (heating cost allocator, Sontex Radio)
devices.description: Heating cost allocator with Sontex Radio (433 MHz). OMS/wM-Bus compatible data records (EN 13757-3).

devices.name: Sontex - HCA 868 (heating cost allocator, wM-Bus OMS)
devices.description: Heating cost allocator with Wireless M-Bus (868 MHz, OMS). Telegram decoded per EN 13757-4/OMS.

devices.name: Sontex - HCA 878 (heating cost allocator, LoRaWAN)
devices.description: Heating cost allocator with LoRaWAN radio. Payload follows Sontex "M-Bus frames" (OMS based); decoded per EN 13757-3 data records.

devices.name: Sontex - SUPERAQUA 1 (electronic water meter)
devices.description: Electronic single/multi-jet water meter with optional LoRaWAN/OMS radio. Reports cumulative volume, reading date, monthly values, operating hours, error codes.

devices.name: Sontex - SUPERCAL 5S (static thermal energy meter)
devices.description: Static thermal energy meter with retrofittable LoRaWAN module (REF SC5X00022). Default payload: device identification, fabrication number, RTC, flow, power, energy/volume tariff 0.

devices.name: Sontex - SUPERSTATIC 789 (ultrasonic compact heat meter)
devices.description: Compact static (ultrasonic oscillator) heat meter, LoRaWAN option. Measures heating/cooling energy, volume, flow and temperature difference; 18 months history.

devices.name: Sontex - Supercom W2-L (LoRaWAN radio module for Elster water meters)
devices.description: Battery-powered LoRaWAN add-on module for Elster S110 PICOFLUX EF / M140 MODULMETER water meters. Reports cumulative volume, reading date, 15 monthly values, battery operating hours, tamper/error info.
